name: agent-evals
description: Evaluate tool-using AI agents with scenarios, deterministic checks and a calibrated LLM judge
author: Rafael Camillo

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run deps && npm run coverage
scripts.example: npm run build:examples && node dist/bin/cli.js run examples/harbor/scenarios --judge-model claude-sonnet-5 --repeat 5 --prices examples/harbor/prices.json --agent dist-examples/harbor/agent.js --out runs/agent.json --markdown runs/agent.md
scripts.example:calibrate: npm run build && node dist/bin/cli.js calibrate examples/harbor/calibration --judge-model claude-sonnet-5
scripts.example:compare: node dist/bin/cli.js compare runs/baseline.json runs/agent.json --markdown runs/comparison.md
scripts.example:baseline: npm run build:examples && node dist/bin/cli.js run examples/harbor/scenarios --judge-model claude-sonnet-5 --repeat 5 --prices examples/harbor/prices.json --agent dist-examples/harbor/baseline.js --out runs/baseline.json --markdown runs/baseline.md
